proposals.problem: The old structural PRD schema could accept READY without a real interrogation record.

alternatives.description: Keep instruction-only questioning and structural PRD validation.
tradeoffs: Low overhead, but missing dialogue can be invisible.

alternatives.description: Use distinct interrogator/responder messages, coverage record, retained receipts and hash-bound v2 dependencies.
tradeoffs: More auditability and fail-closed document checks; requires extra context and actual transport.

criteria: Respect user authority and paused work.
proposals.hypothesis: Explicit dialogue plus record-integrity checks prevents the demonstrated documentary closure loophole.
proposals.falsifier: A validator accepts COMPLETE with a material open dimension or READY with an incomplete interview.

limitations: Technical repair pattern is implemented under repair authorization; this is not a new human business-policy decision.
Runtime-wide mandatory enforcement by every LLM is not proven.
